scope: Theorem 9.1 (Compatible regularization) of the manuscript “Purely cosmetic surgery on knots in the three-sphere” (preprints/Purely-Cosmetic-Surgery-on-Knots-in-the-Three-Sphere-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 306 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ee916c92b825a868), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 107. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the fixed finite family, equation perturbations and representatives can be chosen arbitrarily small in the prescribed norms with the following properties. 1. Ordinary irreducible equations and the labelled sphere, surface, and point tests are transverse, including the relevant ideal and broken strata. Their representatives have the exact support and persistence properties of Lemma 9.10. They are compatible with fixed determinant gluing, marked translation on cylinders, and all true faces. Prescribed harmonic reducers on separated caps are preserved. 2. Single-component, single-valued equivariant perturbations give the fixed-type regularity in Definition 8.7. Every tuple of fixed type is consequently excluded except the legitimate unbroken cut-down instantons. 3. A finite collection of rational multisection terms, in addition to single-valued terms, eliminates every forbidden mixed ideal stratum by the negative dimension of its necessary projection. No equation or retained cut on this projection depends on discarded R fields or their particles. The allowed free stratum is regular of dimension one, and the single trace-end main problem is regular of dimension zero. Choices on the exterior of a separated lens cap agree under the corresponding bit flip. 4. Solutions have the compactness, removable-singularity, integral particle-charge, and exponen- tial true-end properties proved below. Near each legitimate instanton, the phase-cut link has oriented count 2η times its instanton sign, where η = ntot D − 1. The finite branch lists have compatible weighted germs and total weight one. After the no-particle end gluing of Section 10, their oriented one-dimensional zero sets obey the ordinary rational Stokes rule.
